display_name: Los Angeles Basin, CA Metro Retail

econometric_drivers.title: South Coast Air Basin CaRFG Island & CARBOB Spot Pass-Through
econometric_drivers.description: Models Southern California's isolated PADD 5 CARBOB refining complex and strict South Coast Air Quality Management District (SCAQMD) / CARB Phase 3 reformulated gasoline mandates. Retail pricing is driven by prompt Los Angeles CARBOB wholesale spot basis, CEC Southern California refinery utilization rates, early spring summer-blend RVP cutovers (6.99 psi cap), and San Pedro Bay waterborne import arbitrage.

refining_logistics.title: Southern California Refining Cluster (~1.02M bpd Operable Capacity)
refining_logistics.description: Anchored by the dense South Bay and Harbor refining corridor: Marathon Carson/Wilmington (363 kbpd), Chevron El Segundo (269 kbpd), PBF Energy Torrance (166 kbpd), Phillips 66 Wilmington (139 kbpd), and Valero Wilmington (85 kbpd). Supplies Southern California, Orange County, the Inland Empire, Las Vegas, and Phoenix via Kinder Morgan SFPP West, South, and East pipeline systems.

tax_structure.title: CARB Environmental Tax, Cap-and-Trade & LA County Sales Tax Burden
tax_structure.description: California imposes $0.953/gal state environmental tax and regulatory fee burden ($0.596 excise + $0.234 Cap-and-Trade + $0.088 LCFS + $0.035 UST/fees), yielding $1.407/gal total statutory tax with Federal excise ($0.184/gal) and Los Angeles County/Metro district sales taxes.
tax_structure.notes: CARB Phase 3 CaRFG mandate + South Coast AQMD Rule 461 vapor recovery compliance

infrastructure_delivery.title: Los Angeles CARBOB Spot & Watson Station Rack Margin Dynamics
infrastructure_delivery.equation_latex: \text{Rack Margin}_{\text{LA}} = P_{\text{LA Retail}} - P_{\text{LA CARBOB Spot}} = \$4.890 - \$2.890 = \$2.000/\text{gal}
infrastructure_delivery.description: Reflects prompt Los Angeles CARBOB wholesale spot benchmark (EIA EER_EPMRU_PF4_RLA_DPG), Kinder Morgan Watson Station (Carson) terminal injection, SCAQMD 6.99 psi summer volatility cap, and Newport-Inglewood / Palos Verdes fault seismic monitoring.
